newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay mulls fare surcharge over fuel.
newsitem.headline: Cathay mulls fare surcharge over fuel.

text.p: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said on Thursday it was considering imposing a surcharge on its passenger tickets as a result of recent surges in fuel prices.

"Certainly airlines around the world are facing a very considerable spike in fuel prices since the beginning of this year, well up on last year, and therefore frankly are having to consider whether or not they should implement, as has happened in the past when there has been a spike in fuel prices, a surcharge," chairman Peter Sutch told reporters.

"As far as Cathay is concerned we haven't escaped the fuel price increase. Like everybody else, we have the problem, and so consideration is being given to it. But no decision has been made," he said.
